_help: Hand fixes applied by build.mjs (task K.4). Positions are [lat, lon] from Google Maps (right-click a spot, click the numbers to copy).
landmarkPins: { "<landmark id>": [lat, lon] } places a landmark OSM lacks or has wrong (ids in docs/MAP-SPEC.md).
removeBuildings: [{ "at": [lat, lon], "radius": 0, "note": "" }] removes the building under the point, or every building centred within radius metres.
addBuildings: [{ "pts": [[lat, lon], ...], "floors": 2, "style": "market", "note": "" }] adds a building. Styles: plain, old, colony, market, campus, outskirts, industrial.
waterWidths: [{ "name": "Kurnool Cuddapah Canal", "width": 20, "note": "" }] sets the width in metres of rivers and canals OSM only has as lines, matched by name.
clearProps: [{ "at": [lat, lon], "radius": 15, "note": "" }] keeps trees, poles, hoardings and places of worship out of a circle.
A correction that matches nothing stops the build with an error, so typos never pass silently.
